image_description: A museum display featuring a large Triceratops skull fossil in the foreground, characterized by three horns and a large frill. In the background, partially obscured by the fossil and glass reflections, is a human figure wearing a blue shirt, seemingly observing or working near the exhibit. A text label is visible on the left wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fossil skull clearly displays the iconic triceratops morphology with two large brow horns and a smaller nasal horn.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: As this is a fossilized skull, the keratinous beak (soft tissue) is not preserved/visible, only the bony rostrum.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the skull is visible; the body and limbs are outside the frame or not part of the exhibit shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large bony frill is clearly visible behind the eye sockets and horns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill appears solid and consistent with fossilized bone texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No skin or soft tissue is present as this is a dry fossil specimen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Body and limbs are not visible.

artifact_observations.location: Left side, white paper label on wall
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the museum label is illegible and blurry, typical of AI generation struggling with small text details, though it mimics the layout of a real label.

The human figure in the background has a 'painted' or smudged appearance with indistinct facial features and unnatural blending into the background, suggesting AI difficulty with complex background subjects.
The serrated/spiked structure on the right side of the frill appears somewhat irregular and melts slightly into the background, lacking the crisp definition of a real fossil edge.

Texture realism of the fossilized bone
